title: Depth-five circuits for iterated matrix multiplication
description: The (1,1) entry of a product of n matrices of size n x n, and arithmetic circuits with five alternating layers of sums and products in which every gate computes a homogeneous polynomial. The theorem: over a field of characteristic zero such a circuit needs at least n^(sqrt(n)/400) gates for large n, and n^(sqrt(n)+4) gates suffice; with a complete proof. The tools: a rank measure built from partial derivatives and multiplications, and two traces computed by sums over paths. The course is an exposition of OpenAI's proof (2026).

units.title: Iterated matrix multiplication and depth-five circuits
A rank measure from differentiation and multiplication
The rank of a depth-five circuit
The sum over type words and the lower bound

prerequisites: core course Linear Algebra (B40): rank, trace, adjoint, orthogonal projection, determinants
